newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ SPORT-CRICKET-Two NZ cricketers named in CD team.
newsitem.headline: NZ SPORT-CRICKET-Two NZ cricketers named in CD team.

text.p: PALMERSTON NORTH, Oct 9 - New Zealand batsmen Craig Spearman and Mark Greatbatch have been named in a Central Districts President's 11 to play a Wellington 11 on October 20, NZPA reports.
Spearman will make his first appearance in a Central Districts side since shifting from Auckland.
The team is far from a shadow Central selection but one for the selectors to try players out, especially in the bowling.
The President's 11 doesn't include Central's five players touring with the New Zealand Academy 11.
The one-day match will be played at Rathkeale College, near Masterton.

Central Districts President's 11 to play a Wellington 11: Craig Spearman (Hawke's Bay), Glen Sulzberger (Taranaki), Matthew Walker (Taranaki), David Cooper (Wanganui), Mark Greatbatch (Hawke's Bay), Mathew Sinclair (Manawatu), Jacob Oram (Manawatu), Eric Austin (Wanganui), Rodney Brown (Taranaki), Craig Findlay (Hawke's Bay), Roger Fouhy (Hawke's Bay), David Blake (Hawke's Bay).
